answer.reason: The verses tell two defining events at Gihon: Solomon's anointing there and Hezekiah's diversion of its upper watercourse.

clauses.english: was where Zadok and Nathan anointed Solomon king over Israel
clauses.quote: Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon

clauses.english: had its upper watercourse stopped by Hezekiah and brought straight down to the west side of the city of David
clauses.quote: stopped the upper watercourse of Gihon, and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David

doubts: The second clause is slightly over the usual length; the quote is trimmed to the key words.
1KI 1:39 context names the anointing at Gihon only by implication ("anointed Solomon"); the place is named in 1KI 1:38 and 1:45.
